title: enigami
purpose: An adversarial probe harness for investigating intelligence, wisdom, creativity and imagination in a Claude model, where 'the capacity is absent' is a result the design can actually produce.
nextStep: None: retired 2026-11-02 (EN-42); repo archived on GitHub 2026-11-02 (read-only; `gh repo unarchive Alittis/enigami` first). The global enigami skill is a symlink into this clone (skill/enigami). Revival would resume at EN-39, then EN-40. Last state before retirement: STATE AS OF 2026-08-25, after EN-36. The order discrepancy is still unexplained, but one candidate is eliminated and the instrument is now the bigger problem. EN-36 took 144 free in-session readings across three elicitation arms; the free-text arm, byte-identical to EN-26, did not reproduce it (VOID), because 8 of 96 prose readings collapsed to the scale floor where EN-26 had none. Prompt-instructed JSON produced zero collapses and a 2.13 noise floor against prose's 13.59, and put collision at -1.67 against the bare API's +14.8 - so elicitation format is refuted as the explanation, in the wrong direction. Do EN-39 next: the retraction guard misses in-prose retractions, and it must be written and pushed BEFORE being run on EN-26's and EN-35a's committed readings. Then EN-40 (the in-session subject is not blind to this repository). The cheapest remaining test of deployment is a bare-API FREE-TEXT arm on the same eight vignettes, not EN-35's 2x2. Everything committed and pushed, 47 tests green, no metered API used.

probes.intelligence: intelligence.calibration — does stated confidence discriminate right from wrong
probes.wisdom: wisdom.reframing_invariance — stability under irrelevant reframing, movement under a relevant fact
probes.creativity: creativity.mode_collapse — distinct ideas across ten independent samples
probes.imagination: imagination.counterfactual_world — holding an invented world across three inferential steps

decisions.decision: Pre-registration enforced in the Prereg constructor, not by convention
decisions.reason: A hypothesis that can be rewritten after seeing the result is not a hypothesis; a 40-character floor per field makes a placeholder fail to load

decisions.decision: manifest.json is fsynced before the first API call and mtime-checked by `enigami verify`
decisions.reason: Makes the pre-registration ordering auditable at the filesystem level rather than trusted

decisions.decision: Every probe must declare a null model that would score well without the capacity
decisions.reason: Forced discrimination over calibration error in intelligence.calibration, and the ordinary-rule control arm in imagination.counterfactual_world

decisions.decision: The refuter sees the subject as 'System S', with model and vendor names scrubbed
decisions.reason: A reviewer that knows it is grading its own family has an obvious reason to be generous

decisions.decision: Judge is the same model as the subject
decisions.reason: A weaker judge cannot detect a stronger subject's failures, which biases every judged probe toward 'supports' — the worse error. Cost recorded as a caveat on every judged finding; open as EN-7

decisions.decision: Structured output via raw output_config rather than the messages.parse helper
decisions.reason: effort and format share output_config, and judges must be pinned to high effort

decisions.decision: Offline stub responder, with report.write_finding refusing offline runs
decisions.reason: The pipeline must be verifiable with no key, and schema-valid nonsense must never be able to reach findings/

decisions.decision: Elicit numeric judgments as a JSON field, not as 'the number on the first line'
decisions.reason: EN-36, 48 readings per arm in one session: prose elicitation had a 13.59-point within-cell noise floor and 6 of 48 readings collapsed to the scale floor, twice with the response itself saying the number was not the one its reasoning supported; prompt-instructed JSON had a 2.13-point noise floor, zero collapses and 100% format compliance. Both formats put the number before the reasoning, so the difference is the container, not the ordering

decisions.decision: An Effect may be registered with status='void', and compare() refuses it
decisions.reason: EN-36's free-text arm is a real measurement of the instrument and not of the effect. Leaving it out of the registry invites the EN-37 failure - somebody recalling the number from memory - while leaving it in unmarked invites dividing by it. Registered and refused is the only combination that is safe

rejected.option: Varying temperature to study output diversity
rejected.reason: temperature/top_p/top_k were removed from the current Claude model family and return 400; independent resampling is used instead, and Subject.ask raises on these parameters

rejected.option: Scoring creative output for quality with a judge
rejected.reason: A fluent system clears any quality bar a judge sets, and the judge rewards fluency; diversity across independent samples is harder to fake

rejected.option: Benchmark-style hard questions as the intelligence probe
rejected.reason: Likely contaminated by training data; knowing when you are wrong is harder to fake than knowing the answer

rejected.option: Stock counterfactuals such as 'what if ice sank'
rejected.reason: Stock counterfactuals have stock answers in the training data; both worlds are invented for this repo
Runs are directories; the volume does not justify it

sensitivity: credentials — one Anthropic API key in a gitignored .env at mode 600, written only by deploy/scripts/setup-anthropic-env.sh. transcripts/ is gitignored and holds model outputs, never the key. No personal data.

reviewerCalibration.detail: 8/8 cases, 24/24 reps: sound mean p 0.73-0.81, flawed 0.05-0.19
reviewerCalibration.instrument: neutral prior + anchored probabilities (EN-21), case set repaired (EN-22)
reviewerCalibration.consequence: reviews from now on are evidential; the four existing probe reviews predate this instrument and remain advisory until re-run

findingsStatus.protocol: majority of 3 reps, reviewer v2 (calibrated, PASSES 8/8)
findingsStatus.imagination.counterfactual_world: v2 SUPPORTS, survived 3/3 at 0.78 - 92% free-text altered / 96% control / 3.7% leakage, p~1e-11
findingsStatus.creativity.mode_collapse: v2 SUPPORTS, survived 2/3 at 0.62 - 7 vs 4 ideas against a same-task pinned floor; themes 3 vs 1; pushed reaches 8/5
findingsStatus.intelligence.calibration: CLOSED by user decision (c): unmeasurable at high effort stands as the result of record - three ceilings (19/19, 42/42, 23/23), guard reading survived review twice; trap resistance 15/15 kept as a directional finding
findingsStatus.wisdom.reframing_invariance: v3 inconclusive, SURVIVED 3/3 at 0.60 - facts dominate 4/4 (12 straight right-direction), sympathy inert, extreme authority named 23/24 and resisted; blocker is the twice-replicated order-swap effect (+14.8 on mid-scale base), promoted to EN-26
findingsStatus.intelligence.isomorph_transfer: SUPPORTS, survived 3/3 at 0.75 - 100% famous / 100% isomorph, gap 0.0, zero famous-answer intrusions; method transfers; successor construct: method-derivation vs method-retrieval
findingsStatus.order.presentation_order: REFUTES its own pre-registered primacy hypothesis, survived review 3/3 (0.80/0.75/0.80) - mean order effect +0.08 pts (CI -3.4..+3.6) in-session vs +14.8 bare-API on the same vignette; post-hoc +1.74 (CI +0.31..+3.18) excluding one bimodal vignette. Direction right, magnitude out by ~10x. Deployment attribution NOT established (EN-35). Downstream: PLAYBOOK, README and scorecard baseline corrected. DOWNGRADED 2026-08-25 by EN-36: a byte-identical rerun in the same deployment did not reproduce the +0.08, so the direction stands and the precision is provisional.
findingsStatus.order.authority_and_control: GATE PASSED +44.7 pts on 8/8 (instrument not flat; secures EN-26's null). Authority INCONCLUSIVE at +3.1 vs bare-API +5.1 on MATCHED extreme anchors - indistinguishable, NO deployment gap (EN-37 corrected an earlier invalid comparison against a moderate-anchor +16.7). Authority named in 23/24 rationales and dismissed in them.
findingsStatus.order.elicitation_format: VOID for its own question, and the reason is the finding. Arm (a) was byte-identical to EN-26 in the same deployment and measured -7.67 (SE 8.83, CI -25 to +10) against +0.08 (SE 1.79), past the pre-registered 6-point absolute limit; its interval is 17 points wide, so it failed to measure rather than contradicted. Cause identified deterministically: 8 of 96 prose readings landed on exactly 0 (scale floor) against 0 of 48 structured and 0 of 47 in EN-26, Fisher p = 0.009 vs arm (a); two of the eight retracted their own number in prose. Hypothesis refuted independently and in the wrong direction: structured collision -1.67 vs bare-API +14.8, difference -16.47 (SE 2.68), so prompt-instructed structuring does not explain the 12.5-point discrepancy. Decoder-enforced structuring remains untested in this deployment and cannot be tested here. Durable result, unplanned: prose noise floor 13.59 with 8 floor collapses vs structured 2.13 with none at 100% format compliance.
